update.augmentation: none; fixed canonical images plus declared data perturbation
update.initialization: all parameters from original VGG20 f0, fresh AdamW moments

attack.query_policy: alternating calibration Base CFs and fixed geodesic mixtures toward target references across all ten targets

calibration_selection: per target: minimize maximum calibration-model population mean hinge, rounded to 1e-6; ties: lower pixel cost, lower r, lower beta

protocol_notes.new_protocol: Exposure/noise calibration and final stress are new; original LF has separate classifiers/augmentation rather than fixed-update image-shift severity evaluation.
protocol_notes.update_adaptation: Reuse original optimizer/lr/scheduler/effective weight decay, define two-epoch post-training update with batch8 and no stochastic augmentation. All model parameters and BN statistics updated. Same protocol for attack/calibration/future models.
protocol_notes.search_approximation: Current GRACE differentiable AdamW surrogate adapted to multiclass CE; one-step minibatch truncation with frozen BN/dropout during search. Every accepted model gets complete two-epoch update on all3181 original training examples. Only128 preselected training images mutable per restart; this restricts bank strength, not a claim of exact WRO.
protocol_notes.geometry: All three distances are exact unregularized Euclidean W2 in original64-dimensional WAE latent coordinates; no box or current-validity constraint
protocol_notes.deployment: returned images Dec(h); Base and LeapFactual images retain original generator outputs; report encode/decode discrepancy
protocol_notes.r_geometry: class-preserving pixel Euclidean W2 on RGB128 canonical training images; paired displacement certificate plus exact assignment verification
protocol_notes.candidate_selection: pool retained points across beta within each split/target/r; evaluate against entire shared feasible bank at r; choose true hinge then pixel cost; no current-classifier checks
protocol_notes.final_selection: r and beta selected only on calibration images/models; final test controls for all beta at selected r frozen before any future evaluation
protocol_notes.runtime: construction wall interval includes Base and compatible baseline generation, attack construction, calibration models and solves, selection, test refinement and freeze; excludes pretrained asset audit and final future evaluation; separately report worker GPU-hours
protocol_notes.pair_scope: User-requested source-target cohorts in both directions; retain original ten-way classifier and all-class training distribution. Historical future checkpoints reused by fixed protocol, never for selection.
